coverage_notes.exclusion_policy: Excluded old grocery closures, old storm disruptions, ongoing known policy restrictions, routine promotions, aid guides, donations, generic inflation, unrelated businesses and search results with unverified publication time.
coverage_notes.assessment: Twelve targeted one-day searches plus nine direct checks found no newly verifiable qualifying U.S. food-access disruption since the prior completed heartbeat. One USDA page inaccessible; results therefore do not imply nationwide absence.
